primer: The Progressive Corporation is a U.S. property and casualty insurer covering 40.489 million policies in force across personal auto, commercial auto, and property lines. In FY2025, it delivered $81,661 million in net premiums earned, an 87.4% combined ratio, $11,308 million in net income, and a 35.3% ROE. At $237.35 (14.67x forward P/E, 3.99x P/B), the stock sits in a confirmed Stage 2 uptrend, but Q3 2026 premium growth slowed to +4% YoY and CMP offers only 0.76:1 reward-to-risk against our $262.00 base target. We assign WAIT_FOR_SUPPORT, targeting staged entries in the $218.00–$226.27 support zone with a $205.00 invalidation stop (1.68:1 support R:R) while holding 0 shares.
